verdict.rationale: Apify documents exporting datasets into open formats (CSV, JSON, XML, plus XLSX) and loading dataset items into Pandas through its own client, so scraped result data is portable. The evidence covers datasets only, not a complete account-wide export or a documented exit path. Missing for 10: export of all data types (key-value stores, Actor code, tasks, schedules, account settings), a documented full-account export or migration-off-platform process, and independent hands-on corroboration.

citations.quote: This merged dataset can then be exported into various formats such as CSV, JSON, XLSX, or XML.
This allows you to load dataset items directly into a Pandas DataFrame for efficient manipulation and analysis.
